content:
php-forge is the engine behind Blackheart Tech Forge: JSON and HTML in, routed pages out — no build step.

Static pages, projects, and updates all live as editable content. PHP handles routing, templates, lists, and search. Add a JSON file, refresh, it shows up.

This project page is the site eating its own cooking.
